description: Asks which pairs of stored Tx values (a.ID < b.ID) compare equal under four predicates over the 38 x 38 self join: a.T = b.T, a.M = b.M, StrComp(a.T, b.T, 1) = 0 and StrComp(a.T, b.T, 0) = 0, and which pairs differ in Len or LenB while comparing equal. Each is one snapshot of the ID pairs ordered by both IDs, followed by DBEngine.Errors. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

args.text: SELECT a.ID AS ia, b.ID AS ib FROM Tx AS a INNER JOIN Tx AS b ON a.ID < b.ID WHERE a.T = b.T ORDER BY a.ID, b.ID
SELECT a.ID AS ia, b.ID AS ib FROM Tx AS a INNER JOIN Tx AS b ON a.ID < b.ID WHERE a.M = b.M ORDER BY a.ID, b.ID
SELECT a.ID AS ia, b.ID AS ib FROM Tx AS a INNER JOIN Tx AS b ON a.ID < b.ID WHERE StrComp(a.T, b.T, 1) = 0 ORDER BY a.ID, b.ID
SELECT a.ID AS ia, b.ID AS ib FROM Tx AS a INNER JOIN Tx AS b ON a.ID < b.ID WHERE StrComp(a.T, b.T, 0) = 0 ORDER BY a.ID, b.ID
SELECT a.ID AS ia, b.ID AS ib FROM Tx AS a INNER JOIN Tx AS b ON a.ID < b.ID WHERE a.T = b.T AND (Len(a.T) <> Len(b.T) OR LenB(a.T) <> LenB(b.T)) ORDER BY a.ID, b.ID
SELECT a.ID AS ia, b.ID AS ib FROM Tx AS a INNER JOIN Tx AS b ON a.ID < b.ID WHERE a.T = b.M ORDER BY a.ID, b.ID
